## Checklist

- [ ] I signed off every commit (`git commit -s`) and agree to the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No secret values, tokens, real IPs/hostnames or binaries added
- [ ] Collectors remain read-only; no new network calls
